metais help — Print the overview, a command's help, or a topic.

Usage:
  metais help [<command> | <topic> [<command>]] [--json]

With no operand, prints the overview: the commands by group, the global flags,
the topics and the exit codes. With a command's name, prints that command's
help, as metais <command> --help does. With a topic, prints the topic; the topic
refusals takes a command's name after it, and lists every code that command may
refuse with.

With --json, prints the help as one metais.help/1 document: every command's full
declaration and every topic for the overview, or the one command or topic asked
for.

Operands:
  <command> | <topic>
      A command's name, or one of the topics inputs, globs, json, exit-codes and
      refusals.
  <command>
      After the topic refusals, the command whose codes are listed; no other
      topic takes one.

Flags:
  --json
      Print the result as one JSON document on standard output.
  --color <when>
      Colour human output: auto colours a stream that is a terminal when
      NO_COLOR is unset or empty; always and never override NO_COLOR. Values:
      auto, always, never. Default: auto.
  -h, --help
      Print help to standard output and exit 0; nothing else runs.

Prints:
  The help asked for, wrapped at 80 columns, never coloured. With --json, one
  metais.help/1 document.

Refusals:
  usage.bad_value
      A flag's value is missing, or is not one the flag accepts, or a flag that
      takes no value is given one.
      Next: metais help --help
  usage.repeated_flag
      A flag that may be given once is given again.
      Next: metais help --help
  usage.unexpected_operand
      An operand the command does not take.
      Next: metais help --help
  usage.unknown_flag
      An argument that is not a flag the command accepts, an abbreviated flag,
      or one-letter aliases written together.
      Next: metais help --help
  usage.unknown_topic
      The operand names no command and no topic, or the operand after refusals
      names no command.
      Next: metais help

Examples:
  metais help
      Prints the overview.
  metais help limits
      Prints the help of metais limits.
  metais help exit-codes
      Prints what each exit status means.
  metais help refusals render
      Lists every code metais render may refuse with, by its next step.
  metais help --json
      Prints every command's declaration and every topic as one document.
